image.name: orcaslicer
image.description: [Orca Slicer](https://github.com/SoftFever/OrcaSlicer) is an open source slicer for FDM printers. OrcaSlicer is fork of Bambu Studio, it was previously known as BambuStudio-SoftFever, Bambu Studio is forked from PrusaSlicer by Prusa Research, which is from Slic3r by Alessandro Ranellucci and the RepRap community

changelog.desc: Force OrcaSlicer to use the X11 GDK backend to fix UI rendering issues under Wayland.
Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Ubuntu Noble and Selkies, HTTPS is now required.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings and files.

ports.desc: Orca Slicer desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: We set this to 1 gig to prevent modern web browsers from crashing

image.title: Orcaslicer
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  orcaslicer:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/orcaslicer:latest
    container_name: orcaslicer
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb" #optional
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=orcaslicer \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" `#optional` \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/orcaslicer:latest
